welcome.headline: A Charming Retreat in the Heart of Alentejo
welcome.body:
Located in the heart of the Southwest Alentejo and Vicentine Coast Natural Park, just 2 km from the charming village of Zambujeira do Mar, Monte do Papa Léguas is Rural Guesthouse by the sea, a charming retreat where the Alentejo reveals itself in all its authenticity.

Combining tradition and elegance, our home is a true invitation to relax, celebrating the tones, textures and timeless simplicity of Alentejo culture. Here, every detail is designed to provide a memorable experience, in perfect harmony with nature.

Start your day with an artisanal breakfast, full of genuine flavors, prepared with local ingredients and with the care that only Alentejo knows how to offer.

Relax by the pool, immersing yourself in the peaceful rhythm of sunny days, or find serenity in a hammock in the shade of our pine trees. For those who enjoy adventure, we have bicycles available to explore the trails and surrounding landscapes, where every turn reveals new wonders.

Committed to sustainability, we value responsible practices that preserve nature and honor the richness of this unique territory.

At Monte do Papa Léguas, every moment is an invitation to experience the best of Alentejo, we are waiting for you.

spaces.headline: Rooms & Studios
spaces.body: Monte do Papa Léguas offers two types of accommodation: double rooms with private bathroom and studios with kitchenette and porch, comfortable and welcoming, designed for a pleasant and practical stay.

activities.headline: The Alentejo Coast at Your Doorstep
activities.body: We propose several activities to make the most of your stay on the Alentejo Coast and Rota Vicentina — from regional wine tasting to the Sunset Chaser. Contact us for more details.

booking.headline: Book Your Stay
booking.body: Choose your dates and secure the best of the Alentejo Coast.
